title: Operational Correlation Does Not Create Placement Authority
summary: Instrumentation Mesh dev8 can group GCI planning and handoff events by explicit source-supplied correlation, causation and context references. The grouping is an evidence view only.
why: Cross-component operations need trace continuity, but inferred causality would silently turn observation into orchestration truth.
invariants: GCI propagates explicit correlation_id, causation_id and context_refs from caller context.
GCI does not infer correlation from timestamps, resource/node identity, service kind, severity, candidate order or event proximity.
Correlation does not change route admissibility, WLU admission, allocator placement, lease/release authority or execution status.
evidence_note: Grounded in Instrumentation Mesh v0.1-dev8 event contract and GCI v0.1-dev8 test_mesh_dev8_correlation.rex.
